pages.text: Ender Dragon has been changed. The pillars with crystals have been changed and are less protected, but the crystals themselves will recover over time after destruction.$(br2)When destroyed, End crystals will scatter dragon's breath.
The dragon can no longer be damaged by beds or explosions in general.$(br2)The difficulty of the Ender Dragon will change depending on the number of players participating in the battle.

At different points in time, and especially when the boss's health is low, he will launch lightning bolts at everything alive and not alive.$(br2)The boss has become much stronger, and you can't do it with just a diamond enchanted set of armor. I recommend making and mining
arrows with effects, golden apples and totems of undying.
